## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.

This is a suggested change of the backup file naming:
- remove surrounding spaces around the `-` name-datetime-seperator
- remove milliseconds
- use `-` as separator for the hours, minutes and seconds of the timestamp
- use `_` as name-datetime-seperator

old: `Automatic_backup_2025.2.0.dev0_-_2025-01-09_20.14_35457323`
new: `Automatic_backup_2025.2.0.dev0_2025-01-09_20-14-35`

This counts as a breaking change during the beta (_since previous beta-backups might not be restore-able_) but not as a breaking change for the release

The backup_id is an unsalted hash of the backup name + timestamp.
The microseconds (not milliseconds) was added so the filename would have the same level of uniqueness as the old filename.

There's exactly the same discussion in this PR as in the PR which implemented the new filenames, I doubt we will find a naming scheme which everyone likes, and it's clear from the discussion in this PR the proposed changed scheme is not it.

Instead of changing the scheme to another variant which some people will like, and others won't, I think we should add an option to customize the filename in a future release.
Is it worth changing `'_-_'` to `'_'` between name and date as described in the linked issue? This should be less controversial that I think we can do now while we are still in beta.
I opened a PR which only replaces the `_-_` with a single `_`: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/137424

Thanks for creating this PR. The aim of the backup name change is to make it more human-readable while maintaining a unique differentiator (microseconds).

Based on discussions in the Discord beta channel and our forum, it's clear that there are various preferences for naming backups. Some prefer starting with the date, while others use spaces instead of special characters, depending on their system's compatibility.

I suspect we'll see more PRs in the future requesting changes to the default backup name template based on personal preferences. Instead, we should provide an option in the UI for users to create their own backup name template.

To address the linked issue in this PR, let's simplify by changing `_-_` to just `_`. 
_edit: Erik created a PR for this https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/137424_

Feel free to explore creating a custom backup name feature, for instance like this:

review_comments: I think underscore should be used to separate each thing. Ie use underscore to separate the end of the name from the date.

further, what do you think about the order of the parts? 
1. name,version,date: `Automatic_backup_2025.2.0.dev0_2025-01-09_20-14-35`
2. date,name,version: `2025-01-09_20-14-35_Automatic_backup_2025.2.0.dev0`
3. date,version,name: `2025-01-09_20-14-35_2025.2.0.dev0_Automatic_backup`
4. version,date,name: `2025.2.0.dev0_2025-01-09_20-14-35_Automatic_backup`
5. version,name,date: `2025.2.0.dev0_Automatic_backup_2025-01-09_20-14-35`

The version is part of the name, I think. I don't have a strong opinion. It could be nice to sort the files by date by default, even if another name template is used than the one for automatic backups. :shrug:

I think we should stick with 1 for now. We have ideas to see if we want to allow customization in the future, but that is not for now.

The reason to stick with 1 is that it actually covers more use cases right now. The current naming allows sorting by name to group/sort similar types of backups, while the file's metadata can just be sorted by the file system (e.g., sorting on the file's creation date).
ok ... last question (_just to be sure_) - removing the milliseconds is OK, or were they added on purpose?

My preference would be 1 as well. But I'd prefer to not have underscores. All file systems allow spaces. Having all these underscores makes it hard to read. So my preference would be: `Automatic backup 2025.2.0.dev0 2025-01-09 20-14-35.tar`

For Google Drive, this format can change anytime without being a breaking change. Because the Google Drive integration has platinum quality scale, I'm approving this now so that you can merge it if needed without needing my approval or an admin to merge. But do wait for someone else to approve before merging, and after you replace '-' with ' ' between name and date.
